asset.name: Quote counter-offer
asset.description: Sent to the sales rep when an approver proposes a different discount.
asset.subject: Counter-offer on {{customer}} quote {{quote_id}}: {{task_data.approved_discount_pct}}%
asset.html_body:
An approver proposed a counter-offer

Hi,

The {{decided_by}} did not approve {{discount_pct}}% on quote {{quote_id}} for {{customer}}, but will approve {{task_data.approved_discount_pct}}%.

Conditions: {{task_data.conditions}}

Comment: {{task_data.comment}}

The quote is updated in the CPQ system as a counter-offer. Take it back to the customer or resubmit with a new justification.

Sent by the quote approval workflow
